observation.visible_scene: A calm lake at low sun, viewed from a wooden dock. A white boat with a red center stripe and dark windshield is moored alongside the left edge of the dock; a thin rope runs from the dock's right side off-frame. The far shore is lined with coniferous trees, the sun sits low on the left horizon producing a bright golden glare and its mirror reflection, and a horizontal band of mist hovers over the water with wisps rising among the trees. The dock's planks carry a long diagonal shadow.
visible_changes: The mist over the lake slowly drifts and reshapes: the golden-lit wisps on the left and the central fog band change density and outline from frame 1 to frame 41, and the haze above the background trees shifts subtly.
The boat, dock, mooring rope, tree line, sun position, and dock shadow remain fixed in place and orientation relative to the frame throughout the excerpt.
The water surface stays glassy with stable tree reflections; no object translation, deformation, or occlusion event is visible.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the mist later clears or thickens, and whether the boat is eventually moved, lies outside this segment.
The cause of the fog's motion (wind, temperature) is not shown.
uncertain_details: Camera motion is uncertain but appears static: background landmarks (dock, boat, trees, sun) hold constant pixel positions, so no pan/zoom is detected.
The precise direction and speed of the mist drift are hard to pin down from these samples; only slow, continuous morphing is supported.
Tiny water-surface ripples, if any, are not reliably distinguishable from compression noise.
